note: Object sprites for the preview's DE textures view, extracted 2026-11-23 by tools/extract-constants --object-data from empires2_x2_p1.dat. graphic id -> [file, frames, angles, mirroring, layer, deltas]: file is the SLD base name in drs/graphics (empty for none), mirroring is the dat's mirroring mode (non zero when the later angles are mirrors of the earlier), layer is the dat's draw layer, deltas are [graphic, x, y] drawn in order, -1 being the graphic itself, offsets in sprite pixels. Only graphics an object stands as, and their deltas.
